rows.claim: RWCR saturates at rural d=20: the non-default baselines' best RWCR lie within 0.01
rows.survives_calibrated_channel: yes (spread 0.0025; cell unaffected); but saturation BREAKS in rural d=80 (0.136) and urban d=20 (0.413)
rows.survives_sumo: no at rural d=20 (spread 0.0130 vs the 0.01 threshold)
rows.verdict: exploratory: holds at rural d=20 in the fallback simulator (spread 0.0025) and under R9, but not on SUMO (0.013) or in the dense calibrated cells

rows.claim: The per-cell best baseline differs from cell to cell
One fixed setting (dvcast(n_slots=30)) is within 13% of per-cell tuning in every headline cell
rows.survives_calibrated_channel: no (best fixed becomes slotted_1p(n_slots=8); rural d=80 fixed 6.46 vs oracle 5.03)
rows.survives_sumo: no (best fixed slotted_1p(n_slots=50); fails q* in 1 cell(s))
rows.verdict: exploratory (backend- and setting-dependent; R3: best-fixed identity unstable)

rows.claim: Agent matches coverage at rural d=20 with regret +1.8% / margin +1.9% (seed 0)
rows.survives_tolerance: regret sign kept in 8/18; margin flips without interpolation (+1.9% -> -0.8%)
rows.survives_calibrated_channel: yes (cell unaffected; margin +25.3% vs the new fixed best)
rows.survives_sumo: not tested (agent not run on SUMO)

rows.claim: Agent qualifies at rural d=20 on every training seed
rows.verdict: robust in the fallback simulator at q* <= 0.95 (fails at q* 0.98 for seed 0)

rows.claim: Agent never reaches the sparse cell (rural d=2)
rows.survives_sumo: not tested (SUMO's rural d=2 ceiling is 0.221)

rows.claim: Agent reaches 3 of 4 cells on most seeds (seeds 2-4)
rows.survives_calibrated_channel: no (1/1/1/1/1: seeds 2-4 lose rural d=80 and urban d=20)

rows.claim: Agent is faster (lower median TIR) than the reference baselines
rows.survives_tolerance: n/a (latency not part of the target)
rows.survives_calibrated_channel: not re-tested beyond rural d=20 (identical there)

rows.claim: The learned confidence gate adds value
rows.verdict: refuted as stated: a rate-matched random gate qualifies 3/4 cells on all seeds vs 2.2 +/- 1.1; the learned gate is cheaper only where all qualify

rows.claim: GATv2 attention is not what earns the result (GCN / MLP / star ablations)
rows.n_training_seeds: 2 per ablation, 5 for the full model
rows.verdict: exploratory (MLP clearly worse on the common cell; GCN/star within seed spread)

rows.claim: The causal relevance feature is needed (R7 removal ablation)
rows.verdict: not supported (removal stays within the full model's spread)

rows.claim: The simulator is optimistic in dense traffic (validation gap)
rows.survives_sumo: consistent (SUMO lowers sparse and urban ceilings; README backend comparison)
